body:
How much validation coverage is lost through test-recognition, command-targeting and output-parsing assumptions? Follow-up to #28, initially using SAMtools and MNE as distinct cases.

**Evidence:** SAMtools had 219 `no_new_test_funcs` decisions; the default recognizer supports Python/Go/JS forms but misses C/Perl/shell/fixture conventions. File descriptors alone do not establish how many rejected patches contain usable regression tests. MNE’s saved positional `mne/` command prevented narrowing; all six returned stages timed out, and the pinned parser did not recognize colored statuses. [Diagnosis and source references](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/f4407421/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/interpretation.md).

**First investigation:** define a deterministic small sample of SAMtools rejected diffs and classify actual test conventions without calling a model. Separately reproduce MNE parsing on bounded retained-format fixtures and examine generic command-targeting behavior. State supported runners explicitly. Turning off `require_new_test_funcs` alone is not evidence of executable test support.

**Comparison proposal:** evaluate a general runner-aware filter/selection/parser change against frozen cases, with fixtures covering ANSI output, failures, collection errors, skips, summaries and truncated logs. Preserve meaningful test IDs and require completed runner execution before accepting a task; never promote original partial logs into newly validated results. Timeouts and test-scope changes need separately reported comparisons.

**Success criteria:** measured candidate coverage and parsing correctness, with complete positive controls for any live recovery claim. No weakened test contract, per-PR command editing or extra LLM repair loop. Do not assume unsupported test conventions imply unsuitable repositories. LAMMPS action-to-shell protocol handling is a separate bootstrap-interface problem retained in #28’s diagnosis, not silently folded into test-result parsing.

**Execution and reporting:** initial evidence/source review has $0 model spend and launches no remote jobs. Before execution, checkpoint exact cases, revisions, configurations, resource bounds and a cumulative cost allowance; do not treat #28’s unused ceiling as a fresh budget. Use the official pipeline with explicitly justified, general changes only; no added LLM/Codex repairs of individual tasks or environments. Preserve baseline and comparison results separately, archive eligible evidence with verified readback, and clean up owned resources. Keep the body a concise current summary and detailed investigation logs in comments. Research branches remain separate from main.
